limitations: No new recorded reference fixture (an inline fixture kind would need the Rust harness; no-Rust constraint). The real stack's exact outputs are machine-dependent, so its gates assert the pinned structural invariants (wrap clamping, row stacking, box growth, snapping, cache stability) rather than bit-exact traces; the deterministic TestTextSystem corpus carries the exact derived expectations.

A wrapped row's width keeps the trailing break space in its advance (the pinned Parley line semantics: InlineVisualLine.size = metrics.advance, unclamped); rows may exceed the wrap width by up to one space, and the greedy breaker's unbreakable-word overflow applies only from an empty row (both recorded in the tests and the algorithm header).

Inline-specific overflow clipping is exercised through the shared content-mask path (the same WithContentMaskVoid machinery as non-inline divs) and is not separately gated at the fragment level; text glyph clipping observability would need sprite-level inspection.

Failed/reentrant measurement histories are covered at the engine level (layoutspec reentry rejection and independent-engine nesting tests, ticket06) — an inline paragraph measure closure that itself fails (shaping error) propagates the panic into the layout status like any measure failure, which is the shared engine behavior, not separately re-gated here.

The mid-word cluster-breaking deviation across segment boundaries (a segment that does not fit moves wholesale to the next row unless it overflows from an empty row) and the row-clamp trailing-break drop remain as recorded in inline_real.go's header; both derive from the no-Rust constraint on the shaping ABI.
